shortened: By this "day" is meant the Day of the Great Resurrection, the Day of Judgement, for on that Day there shall appear such signs and events, such splendours and occurrences, marvels and wonders, truths and mysteries, precepts and writings, that the revelation of those splendours and signs cannot be contained even in fifty thousand years. Moreover, the precepts and laws, and the writings, teachings, and manifold bounties associated with that Day, which is none other than the "appointed time of a known day", shall remain valid and binding for a full thousand years, nay for five hundred thousand years. Such a span of time is merely an approximation that alludeth to ages and centuries.

order.why: Read the extended account of a cycle’s duration in its supplied translation.
shortened: The Cycle of the Blessed Beauty is endless. Only after ages and epochs have passed, and when entirely the Tablets, Books, Writings, invocations and traces of this Dispensation shall have been effaced, to the degree that naught of the teachings of the Blessed Beauty remaineth in men's hands---then will a new Manifestation appear. Otherwise, so long as the traces, Tablets, teachings, utterances, mysteries and lights of the Blessed Beauty are manifest in the world of existence, there shall be no appearance, no rising, no forth-going of another Dispensation.

order.why: Consider the distinction between a Day and a longer cycle.
shortened: That Light of Truth - its outpouring is all-encompassing and its grace is perfect, whether in the Day of Manifestation or after its setting. Its Day is a thousand years and its cycle is a hundred thousand years.

order.why: Keep the particular letter’s expansive language of duration.
shortened: His Day is five hundred thousand years and His Dispensation will endure unto eternity.

order.why: Read the image of further letters of knowledge still to unfold.
Preserve the letter’s language of authority and duration in its historical and translated setting.
Consider the present focus of devotion alongside the future Manifestation.
shortened: And today the center of attention and the object of supplication and imploring is the Abha Beauty (may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones) until the Manifestation who will come after the thousand years.
This is the truth, and after truth there is nothing but manifest error.

order.why: Addresses the duration of the cycle and future Manifestations.
Hear the reported possibility of a thousand or thousands of years.
shortened: The Promised One of the Blessed Beauty will come after a thousand years or thousands of years.

order.why: Read the reported clarification that the interval is not fixed at exactly a thousand.
Consider the report’s explanation of large numbers as temporal extension.
Keep the reported estimate of a long cycle distinct from a fixed prediction.
Retain the report whose suggestion of less than a thousand years conflicts with the explicit minimum.
Read the reported imagery of the end of a prophetic cycle in its own setting.
shortened: The last of the Days of Judgment will dawn, when the Prophetic Cycle will have come to an end and the world returns to God, when all becomes lost in Him through the crashing and bursting of the elements, which means annihilation for those turned away from God, but spiritualization for those resting in God, and for those souls still in need of purification and development it is a triumphant sinking into God's infinite grace and mercy.

order.why: Keep the reported expectation of turmoil and a return to religion.
shortened: He said: 'Great events would happen and people will become irreligious. There will be tumult and because of irreligion there will be such confusion that all will be indistress. Then they will return to religion. As long as there is no religion, the happiness of the world of man is impossible.'

order.why: Close the linked passages with the reported endlessness of divine bounty.
Read the supplied account of revelation’s indefinitely continuing sunrise.
shortened: ...the Revelation of God may be likened to the sun. No matter how innumerable its risings, there is but one sun, and upon it depends the life of all things.
The process of the rise and setting of the Sun of Truth will thus indefinitely continue--a process that hath had no beginning and will have no end.

order.why: Consider the supplied explanation of future Manifestations under the Ancient Beauty’s shadow.
Distinguish cycle and dispensation in the supplied guidance.
shortened: For while the Dispensation of Baha'u'llah will last for at least one thousand years, His cycle will extend still farther to at least 500,000.... After Baha'u'llah many Prophets will, no doubt, appear, but they will be all under His shadow. Although they may abrogate the laws of the Dispensation, in accordance with the needs and requirements of the age in which they appear, they nevertheless draw their spiritual force from this mighty Revelation.

order.why: Read the first Dispensation within a longer series and its ages.
Consider unending human progress and future laws suited to development.
Read the expectation of a world civilization and its later harvests.
Keep the supplied emphasis on gratitude for the present revelation.
Read the supplied provisional translation of the thousand-year safeguard.
Consider the supplied report’s distinction between the minimum and an unknown longer interval.
shortened: He is the Unique and Peerless One till the next Manifestation. It is, however, not definite that it will be 1,000 years; it may be 2,000, or 10,000 or 20,000 years; but it is definite that for the coming 1,000 years there will appear no Manifestation; for 1,000 years there shall arise no Sun. All the appearances will be beneath the shade of the Most Great Appearance; they will be as stars of guidance.

order.why: Keep guidance on the Iqan’s general image distinct from the Aqdas’s explicit minimum.
Read the supplied provisional passage about future proofs.
shortened: Although in the present Dispensation all mighty evidences, perspicuous proofs, wondrous Verses, prodigious revelations, and divine stations have been made manifest - all these as a bounty from Our presence unto the entire creation - yet hereafter the matter rests in the hand of God: It is for Him to determine what to assign as proof in the succeeding Manifestations....

order.why: Return to Bahá’u’lláh’s expressed concern for a later Manifestation.
Consider the supplied explanation of future persecution and the Covenant’s protection of unity.
Read the supplied response concerning recognition and the House of Justice.
shortened: There is nothing in the Writings to support the view that the opposition or persecution will be instigated or inflicted by the Universal House of Justice. You are aware, of course, that one of the reasons for the appearance of a new Manifestation of God is to bring forth a spiritual renewal, as the former Dispensation would have passed through its stages of growth and reached its zenith. You can be sure that the Supreme Institution of the Faith, "under the care and protection of the Abha Beauty, under the shelter and unerring guidance of His Holiness, the Exalted One", will exert every effort to recognize, when the time is ripe, the reality of the new Manifestation, and lead men to Him. How the majority of the people at that time will respond is a truth locked up in the treasury of God's knowledge.

order.why: Close with the institution’s foundation in scripture and authority of a future Manifestation.

questions: How can fidelity to a revelation include openness to another revelation in the future?
What distinguishes a minimum interval from a predicted date of arrival?
How does the distinction between a dispensation and a cycle help interpret the different spans of time?
How should translation authority, reported speech, and explicit interpretive guidance affect the way conflicting statements are weighed?
What does Matthew’s call to readiness contribute, and how does it differ from the specific safeguard in the Aqdas?
What habits of discernment and humility might help a community remain faithful without presuming to determine God’s future action?

references.label: 1 · Matthew 24:36–44 · Readiness without knowing the hour
references.note: Jesus speaks of the coming of the Son of man, the limits of knowledge concerning its time, and the need to remain ready. Compare the distinction between readiness and calculation with the compilation’s warning against turning a minimum interval into an exact prediction. Matthew’s Christian expectation has its own setting and does not provide the Aqdas’s thousand-year minimum or the Bahá’í distinction between dispensation and cycle.

subjects.displayTitle: The influence of one soul: faith shared through a life
subjects.introduction: One fragrant flower can perfume a whole rose garden, ‘Abdu’l-Bahá writes, and one star of guidance can lead a hundred thousand caravans. He holds that the guidance of a single soul outweighs the sovereignty of a kingdom, because life passes from the first guide to another, and from that one to another still, until a multitude has been quickened. Five grains of wheat touched by heavenly blessing outweigh a thousand tons of tares; a deed done for God may give life to many. What makes such influence possible is not eloquence but sincerity, detachment and the confirmations of the Spirit, so that a person may teach, as He once told a friend named Juliet, with the heart rather than the tongue. In the Gospel of John a woman’s word draws her neighbours to Jesus until they believe because they have heard him for themselves [1]. The thread runs on toward the power of faith and of the spirit, the methods of teaching, and the reassurance that small numbers are no measure of what a sincere life can awaken.
subjects.arc: Begin with the possible reach of a single deed, examine preparation and selflessness, and follow personal relationships into shared spiritual life.

order.why: Consider quality and fruitfulness beyond numerical size.
shortened: Five grains of wheat will be endued with heavenly blessing, whereas a thousand tons of tares will yield no results or effect. One fruitful tree will be conducive to the life of society, whereas a thousand forests of wild trees offer no fruits. The plain is covered with pebbles, but precious stones are rare. One pearl is better than a thousand wildernesses of sand, especially this pearl of great price, which is endowed with divine blessing. Erelong thousands of other pearls will be born from it. When that pearl associates and becomes the intimate of the pebbles, they also all change into pearls.

order.why: Open with a single deed giving life to many.
Trace the continuing chain through one person teaching another.
shortened: Whosoever succeeds in teaching another soul becomes the cause of that soul's life, and that one in turn becomes the cause of another's life. This chain continues until ultimately that first soul has become the cause of life for a multitude.
Consider what mighty effects result from the guidance of a single soul!

order.why: Read the possibility that one without shelter becomes a refuge.
shortened: Wonder not that one without refuge or shelter may, through God's grace, become a refuge and shelter, and that one without position or status may, through the Lord's bounty, become the founder of the house of peace.

order.why: Explore the images of one flower, star and tree.
shortened: One pure soul can enlighten a world and one fragrant flower can perfume a rose garden. One star of guidance can lead a hundred thousand caravans and one eternal tree can cast its shade over a hundred thousand righteous ones.

order.why: Consider the effect of a single deed on a community.
shortened: Now in that city bereft (of spiritual bounties), one must act with wisdom and awaken the heedless through Baha'i deeds, for deeds have more influence than words. How often has it happened that a single deed from a blessed soul caused a tribe to be guided.

order.why: Read the particular joy of two newly guided souls.
Follow faith transmitted through successive lives.
shortened: The power of the faith of the first guide will be transmitted, find continuation and become manifest in the lives of other believers, until one sanctified soul will become the cause of the quickening a hundred thousand souls. Consider how important this is, for the guidance of one soul is greater than the sovereignty of a kingdom.

order.why: Ask what makes a guide trustworthy.
shortened: Travel not the way without a guide, nor accept every guide's words. Many guides are themselves astray and have not found the right path. A guide is one who is free from the bonds of the world and whom nothing preventeth from speaking the truth.

order.why: Place education in love before the exercise of influence.
shortened: It is the hope of ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá that those youthful souls in the schoolroom of the deeper knowledge will be tended by one who traineth them to love. May they all, throughout the reaches of the spirit, learn well of the hidden mysteries; so well that in the Kingdom of the All-Glorious, each one of them, even as a nightingale endowed with speech, will cry out the secrets of the Heavenly Realm, and like unto a longing lover pour forth his sore need and utter want of the Beloved.

order.why: Consider the awakening of other people’s capacities.
shortened: The bounties of God have so empowered the friends in this divine Dispensation that they can awaken the capacities and guide mankind to the way of salvation by these means.

order.why: Identifies spiritual power as the teacher’s means of influencing hearts.
Read the prayer for knowledge to nourish followers of every religion.
shortened: We beseech God to make him like rain clouds for the soil of His knowledge, that ears of recognition may spring forth therefrom for the followers of all religions.

order.why: Consider the value assigned to one accepted soul.
shortened: I swear by the pearls of the divine ocean of wisdom that a single accepted soul is mightier and greater than all the peoples of the world, for all were created to recognize this most holy and sublime Day, and in all the scriptures the appearance of this mighty Cause was promised; yet they are seen to be deprived and debarred therefrom.

order.why: Read the analogy of one sun illuminating a whole world.
shortened: Should He so will, He could through a single soul subdue the entire world. Observe the sun, which is but one of His signs: through divine confirmations it alone hath conquered the whole world. When such a sign in the horizons is thus observed, this same is proof that He is able, in the realm of the souls of His loved ones, to raise up one soul with such power, might and ascendancy as to subdue all the kingdoms of the earth.

order.why: Keep the imagery of a single horseman within spiritual confirmation.
shortened: If a soul becomes confirmed with these hidden favors, a single horseman can charge against the world's ranks, for the confirmations of the Abha Kingdom and the aid and protection of the Ancient Beauty arrive successively, as you have experienced.

order.why: Consider the compressed comparison of one soul and an army.
shortened: One soul has the effect of an army and one horseman the effect of countless cavalry.

order.why: Read confidence in heavenly assistance.
Consider the spread of a spark and the invitation to hope.
shortened: Consider thou how one spark sets on fire a great forest. Therefore, there is great hope, and the favor and grace of the Almighty is limitless.

order.why: Read a letter’s encouragement for women to become lights for others.
Keep the particular hope for love’s influence in London.
shortened: I shall never forget it, and I cherish the hope that, through the grace of Baha'u'llah, thou shalt be so enkindled in London with the heat of the love of God as to set aflame all who meet thee.

order.why: Consider an address intended to strengthen the recipient’s heart and service.
Read gratitude for a person who brought life and joy to others.
shortened: You became the cause of life for countless souls and the source of happiness and glad-tidings for a mighty throng.

order.why: Consider the reported fruits of effort in particular regions.
shortened: It is evident that, through your efforts, the inhabitants of those regions are now inhaling the fragrances of Musk from the Garden of the Kingdom.

order.why: Keep the practical effect of forwarding Tablets.
shortened: Praise be to God! immense results and great effects have been produced by forwarding [recent] Tablets to that country (America).

order.why: Read the enduring influence of a breath or word from earlier believers.
shortened: Consider how the blessed souls in former times, with but a breath, ultimately made the world fragrant with the merciful breath, and it still continues. And if they uttered a word, a thousand books and scrolls became its interpretation and explanation.

order.why: Consider the humble occupations of Peter and Salman.
Set lasting service beside passing royal power.
Keep the historical report’s comparison of lowly servants and kings.
shortened: Through this service, lowly individuals like Simon and Peter attained the zenith of eternal glory, even though at first no one paid them any attention. But in the end kings and monarchs became humble at the mention of their names.

order.why: Read the reported image of an elixir in Christ’s influence without adopting its historical generalizations.
Consider the report’s claim about a single life transforming the world.
Hear the reported examples of poor and simple people’s influence.
Read the reported encounter with a woman and her spiritual children.
Keep the personal reported affirmation addressed to Juliet.
shortened: "Tell Juliet," began Abdul-Baha at once, "that she teaches well."

"I have met many people who have been affected by you, Juliet. You are not eloquent, you are not fluent, but your heart teaches. You speak with an emotion, a feeling which makes people ask, 'What is this that she has?' Then they inquire!

order.why: Consider the reported relation of transformation to divine bounty and another person.
Hear the reported invitation to rely beyond one’s perceived capacity.
shortened: Do ye not look upon your own capacities. Rest ye assured in the bounties of the Blessed Perfection. He shall change the drop into an ocean and the moth into an eagle. He changes the stone into the precious ruby and the scintilla into the world-illuminating sun.

order.why: Read the reported preference for one living torch.
Keep the reported confidence in one believer’s possible influence.
shortened: Through the power of God it is possible for one Bahai to guide one whole nation. Such spiritual victories are dependent upon the breaths and bestowals of the Holy Spirit.

order.why: Consider the reported hope for a new believer’s effect within a people.
shortened: It is well known, that when once a blessed soul of any nation steps into the religion of God, it is capable of saving the whole community from the darkness of the world, from materialism and animalism.

order.why: Preserve the historical report about an unnamed teacher and island communities.
shortened: "There are three Islands in the Indian Ocean, situated in the equatorial line. The climate is very hot, but they have a population of about 20 millions. Formerly they were idolaters, sun and star worshipers. During the ninth Century of Hegira, a blessed soul arrived there, single and alone, but his intention was in and for God. He continued to teach the simple, democratic principles of Islam, but he was subjected to persecution, cruelty and ignominy. With deep-felt serenity, he suffered all for the sake of his conviction. Through his indefatigable activity, all the people of those three Islands embraced the religion of Islam. He was so self-sacrificing that he did not care to leave behind even his name. when he accomplished his work, he retired from the field, and all his traces were lost….

order.why: Read the parallel reported island narrative as a story of selfless motive.
shortened: The Islands of java, Sumatra and another one which are situated in the Indian ocean in the equator contain about 20 millions of inhabitants. These people were converted from idolatry into Mohamadan religion by one single person. Just think of his attraction and of accomplishing such a mighty task! When he finished his work he left the islands for an unknown destination and after that no one heard anything about him. Even his name is not known. Not it is evident that that one single person was a greater man than a million of the present day Ulemas. For he worked for God and not for fame or name or wealth.

order.why: Keep the letter’s account of a soul influencing a continent.
shortened: How often it hath happened that one blessed soul hath proved to become the cause of guidance unto a continent.

order.why: Consider the report’s emphasis on self-forgetfulness and enduring service.
Read the reported detachment from competing ambitions.
shortened: Today honor and victory are destined for that soul who has freed himself from every thought and is engaged in the exaltation of the Word of God and the diffusion of the Fragrances of God.

order.why: Hear the urgent invitation to make use of an opportunity.
Keep a simple personal call to assist other souls.
shortened: In the city of Qum, due to excessive persecution by the enemies, the friends have been scattered. Now you must be the cause of some souls being guided to the light of guidance.

order.why: Consider association with those who arise to serve.
shortened: Surely souls will arise who will strive with all their power to spread the Word of God, but our desire is that if we are not counted among those souls, we may at least be associated with them.

order.why: Read hope for a small gathering’s future growth.
Hear the reported image of a seed sown in America.
Keep the reported anticipation of a few effective people.
Consider the reported hope placed in a few people in Japan.
Read the reported practical importance of language ability.
shortened: If a number of Persian teachers who are endowed with eloquent tongues knew the English language and travelled to those parts they could attract many souls to the Cause. For example if Mirza Abul Fazl knew English his influence in the West would have been a hundredfold.

order.why: Keep the reported challenge to extend effort to towns and villages.
Close the linked passages with the reported imagery of spiritual quickening.
Ground the supplied guidance in close association and loving service.
Read individual initiative alongside friendship, cooperation and consultative decisions.
shortened: The role of the individual is of unique importance in the work of the Cause.

The individual alone can exercise those capacities which include the ability to take initiative, to seize opportunities, to form friendships, to interact personally with others, to build relationships, to win the cooperation of others in common service to the Faith and society, and to convert into action the decisions made by consultative bodies.

order.why: Consider the supplied distinction between large projects and personal engagement.
Read responsibility for wounded and weary souls alongside teaching.
Connect possible influence with maturity and profound understanding.
Consider the quality of understanding and commitment.
Read the supplied call for dedicated effort.
Close with the supplied encouragement to a small community.

questions: What can the images of seeds, lamps, and a chain of relationships reveal about influence that grows beyond one person?
How do sincerity, knowledge, and preparation contribute differently to teaching?
What distinguishes awakening another person’s understanding from dependence on the teacher?
How can individual initiative work together with consultation and collective effort?
What does the movement from the Samaritan woman’s testimony to her neighbors’ own hearing suggest about sharing faith?
Which ordinary relationship or act of service might offer an opportunity to put these insights into practice?

references.label: 1 · John 4:28–42 · An invitation that leads to personal hearing
references.note: A woman’s testimony brings people from her city to Jesus; they later say that their belief rests on hearing him for themselves. Between these events, Jesus speaks of sowing and reaping in work shared across people. Compare this pattern with the compilation’s chain of influence and its emphasis on personal relationships. John’s account concerns recognition of Jesus as the Christ; it offers a narrative comparison rather than a universal formula for teaching.
